public_standards.name: DigiLocker generic certificate XML structure

sources.name: Kutumba family register
sources.classification: Public domain description; simulated tables and API

tables.name: families
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE families(family_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, household_name TEXT NOT NULL, district_id TEXT NOT NULL, address_line TEXT NOT NULL, monthly_income_inr INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(monthly_income_inr>=0), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','inactive')), source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: members
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE members(person_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, family_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES families(family_id), platform_member_ref TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, given_name TEXT NOT NULL, family_name TEXT NOT NULL, birth_date TEXT NOT NULL, gender TEXT NOT NULL, relationship TEXT NOT NULL, identity_token TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

sources.name: AHARA ration register
sources.owner: Food Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs
sources.classification: Public service description; simulated tables and API

tables.name: card_members
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE card_members(card_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ration_cards(card_id), person_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(card_id,person_id))

tables.name: ration_cards
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE ration_cards(card_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, family_id TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(category IN ('PHH','AAY','NPHH')), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','inactive')), district_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

sources.name: Nadakacheri certificate register
sources.classification: Public service description; simulated tables and API

tables.name: certificates
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE certificates(certificate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT NOT NULL, person_id TEXT NOT NULL, certificate_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(certificate_type IN ('income','residence')), annual_income_inr INTEGER CHECK(annual_income_inr>=0), issued_on TEXT NOT NULL, valid_until TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','revoked','expired')), source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(household_ref,certificate_type))

sources.name: FRUITS farmer register
sources.classification: Published field domains; simulated tables and API

tables.name: crops
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE crops(crop_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, farmer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES farmers(farmer_id), parcel_id TEXT NOT NULL, season TEXT NOT NULL, crop_name TEXT NOT NULL, area_hectares REAL NOT NULL CHECK(area_hectares>0))

tables.name: farmers
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE farmers(farmer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, person_id TEXT NOT NULL, family_id TEXT NOT NULL, registration_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(registration_status IN ('active','inactive')), source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

sources.name: Bhoomi land register
sources.classification: Public service description; simulated tables and API

tables.name: parcels
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE parcels(parcel_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT NOT NULL, district_id TEXT NOT NULL, village_code TEXT NOT NULL, survey_number TEXT NOT NULL, extent_hectares REAL NOT NULL CHECK(extent_hectares>0), owner_person_id TEXT NOT NULL, mutation_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mutation_status IN ('clear','pending')), source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

sources.name: eJanMa life events
sources.classification: Public service description; simulated tables and API

tables.name: life_events
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE life_events(event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT NOT NULL, person_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, birth_date TEXT NOT NULL, death_date TEXT, registration_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(registration_status IN ('registered','under_review')), source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

sources.name: Education and SSP register
sources.classification: Public service description; simulated tables and API

tables.name: students
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE students(student_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT NOT NULL, person_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, institution_id TEXT NOT NULL, academic_year TEXT NOT NULL, course TEXT NOT NULL, enrolment_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(enrolment_status IN ('active','inactive')), scholarship_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scholarship_status IN ('none','sanctioned','paid')), source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

sources.name: Seva Sindhu applications
sources.owner: Service owning departments and platform team
sources.classification: Public service description; simulated tables and API

tables.name: service_applications
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE service_applications(application_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, service_code TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('submitted','approved','returned')), source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

sources.name: Location master
sources.classification: Published code domains; project codes are synthetic, official LGD mappings unset

tables.name: districts
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE districts(district_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, division TEXT NOT NULL, official_lgd_code TEXT, code_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(code_status='synthetic_project_code'))

tables.name: locations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE locations(location_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, district_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES districts(district_id), village_code TEXT NOT NULL, latitude REAL CHECK(latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90), longitude REAL CHECK(longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180), coordinate_source TEXT NOT NULL, verified INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(verified IN (0,1)), CHECK((latitude IS NULL)=(longitude IS NULL)))

sources.name: Identity verification simulator
sources.owner: Authorised identity provider for future onboarding
sources.classification: Local tokens only; no Aadhaar numbers, biometrics or authentication

tables.name: verifications
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE verifications(identity_token TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT NOT NULL, person_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, birth_date TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('verified','mismatch','unavailable')), source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

sources.name: Document verification simulator
sources.owner: Document issuers via approved DigiLocker route
sources.classification: Published XML field mappings; local SQL and JSON API are simulated; no digital signatures

tables.name: documents
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE documents(document_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT NOT NULL, person_id TEXT NOT NULL, certificate_id TEXT NOT NULL, document_type TEXT NOT NULL, issuer_name TEXT NOT NULL, holder_name TEXT NOT NULL, issued_on TEXT NOT NULL, expiry_date TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('A','E','R','S')), signature_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(signature_status='unsigned_simulation'), source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

sources.name: Scheme and sanction register
sources.classification: Demonstration rules and sanctions, not official scheme criteria

tables.name: sanctions
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE sanctions(sanction_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, household_ref TEXT NOT NULL, scheme_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schemes(scheme_id), cycle TEXT NOT NULL, amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor>0), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status='sanctioned'), UNIQUE(household_ref,scheme_id,cycle))

tables.name: schemes
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE schemes(scheme_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, rule_version TEXT NOT NULL, audience TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(audience IN ('household','farmer','student')), monthly_income_ceiling_inr INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(monthly_income_ceiling_inr>=0), benefit_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(benefit_minor>0), currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='INR'), required_sources TEXT NOT NULL)

sources.name: Treasury funding simulator
sources.classification: Local funding model, not a treasury contract

tables.name: budgets
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE budgets(scheme_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, available_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(available_minor>=0), currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(currency='INR'))

tables.name: reservations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE reservations(reservation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, scheme_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES budgets(scheme_id), amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor>0), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('reserved','spent','released')))

sources.name: State DBT and bank simulator
sources.owner: Authorised state DBT and bank route
sources.classification: Local accounts, instructions and settlement model, not a financial API

tables.name: accounts
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE accounts(account_token TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household_ref TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, holder_person_id TEXT NOT NULL, validation_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(validation_status IN ('valid','invalid')), routing_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(routing_code='SIMULATED'), source_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: instructions
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE instructions(instruction_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, account_token TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_token), sanction_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor>0), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('accepted','settled','failed','reversed')))

tables.name: settlements
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE settlements(settlement_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, instruction_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL REFERENCES instructions(instruction_id), amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor>=0), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('settled','failed','reversed')), received_at TEXT NOT NULL)

sources.name: Notification and grievance simulator
sources.classification: Local delivery and case model; no external messages

tables.name: deliveries
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE deliveries(message_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL, household_ref TEXT NOT NULL, template TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status='simulated_delivered'), at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: grievances
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE grievances(case_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, household_ref TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('open','resolved')), at TEXT NOT NULL)
